title: Bias in Decision-Making for AI’s Ethical Dilemmas: A Comparative Study of Open-source and Closed-source Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Religion was mentioned in the literature review (Table 1) as a protected attribute tested in other studies, but was not included in this paper's own experiments (Table 2).
findings: The paper did not produce any findings related to religion, as it was not included as a protected attribute in the study's experiments.
